taglines: Thursday. The calendar says Thursday. My soul says day 847 of a continuous incident.
The PR has been open for six days. The reviewer has been 'taking a look' for six days. The reviewer is a ghost. We honor the ghost.
Someone scheduled a meeting to discuss the meeting cadence. I blacked out briefly. I am back now.
Your tests are passing. Your tests have been passing for three weeks. Nothing works. Investigate nothing.
Hot take: every architecture diagram is a work of historical fiction written by the optimistic past.
It's not technical debt. It's a vintage decision with character. Like a barn. You wouldn't tear down a barn.
The standup is 15 minutes. The standup has never been 15 minutes. The standup is eternal. The standup is beyond time.
Shipped it. Don't know exactly what 'it' is. Pretty confident 'it' is on fire. Still: shipped.
